<!--
Title: use Conventional Commits, e.g. `feat(ui): show labels`. Pull requests
are squash-merged, so the title becomes the commit on main, and release-please
builds CHANGES.md and the release notes from it.

If the change breaks how people use gh-timeline (accepted flags, key
bindings shown in the README or the footer, the format of `-dump` output),
add `!` after the type or scope, e.g.
`feat!: drop the time from -dump event lines`. Changes to how the TUI looks
are not breaking; use `feat` or `fix`. Also add a commit override block to this
description with a breaking-change footer that explains the old behavior,
the new behavior and how to migrate. CLAUDE.md shows the format.
-->
